item.title: Swim and dive: Badgers rally at Big Ten Championships
item.description: The University of Wisconsin men’s and women’s swim and dive teams completed their Big Ten Championship meets over the past couple weeks. The women’s team competed at the University of Minnesota’s Jean K. Freeman Aquatic Center Feb. 18-21, finishing in fourth place for the fifth consecutive year.
